study: Guzman et al. 2021, Read to Learn (ToTAL) early-grade reading RCT, Haiti, RRQ 56(4)
eval_evidence: Evaluation authored by University of Notre Dame researchers, one of whom (Schuenke-Lucien) led the Read to Learn program; the evaluation team is tied to the implementing program (program stake), so not a neutral third party. (Curriculum ToTAL was developed separately by RTI International.)
developer_evidence: ToTAL curriculum was developed by RTI International, but the Read to Learn PD/coaching was delivered by the implementing program's own staff (Read to Learn coaches / Diocesan-supported program), not by RTI the curriculum developer.
cascade_evidence: Program coaches (intermediaries trained to deliver RTI's ToTAL approach) trained and coached the teachers; ≥1 hop between the curriculum developer (RTI) and the classroom teachers.
counterfactual_evidence: Control schools continued standard literacy instruction (status quo); treatment vs business-as-usual comparison.
coaching_evidence: Coaches conducted in-class instructional coaching visits at least once per month, many schools twice or more per month, throughout the program (recurring in-class cycles).
student_dose_evidence: Intervention provides curriculum/materials + teacher training/coaching; the daily scripted lessons are delivered by the regular classroom teacher (changed instruction), not added tutoring/pull-out/extra minutes.
maturity_evidence: Program ran fall 2014-spring 2016; extracted outcomes are the end-of-grade-2 wave (spring 2016), after a prior year (grade 1) of implementation with the same teachers/cohort.
